name: KinematicCharacterController
src_typeComment: One flexible controller for both cases: top-down (useGravity off, allowJump off) and a simple 3D platformer (both on). Built on Unity's own CharacterController component for solid slope/step handling without hand-rolled collision code. Reads input via LegacyInputManager — swap the one line in Update() to NewInputSystemManager.Instance if your project uses the new Input System instead.

src_serialized.name: useGravity
src_serialized.tooltip: Off for a top-down controller (no falling); on for a simple 3D platformer.

src_serialized.name: gravityValue
src_serialized.tooltip: Acceleration applied downward each second while airborne. Negative = downward.

src_serialized.name: jumpHeight
src_serialized.tooltip: Peak jump height in world units; jump velocity is derived from this and gravityValue.

src_serialized.name: rotateToFaceMovement
src_serialized.tooltip: Smoothly rotates the character to face its movement direction.

src_serialized.name: rotationSpeed
src_serialized.tooltip: How fast the character turns to face its movement direction.
